author: Astrokillah
text:
FL-ENGULF-SCALE

For every FL, you need to assign the proper scale to it For every ENGULF, you need to assign the proper scale to it too.

If you cannot do the above properly, then you will end up with the wrong analysis.

So, for every FL you draw, ask yourself, what SCALE it is? and for every ENGULF you have identified, ask yourself the same question, what SCALE it is?

text:
I have received lots of inquiries about how exactly I scalped. I just hit my daily target, so I thought I should just do a quick 'walk-through' on how I trade.

This is EURUSD chart, 5-min, I normally flip through 10 low-spread pairs to look for trade opportunities. And when I saw the chart below, I smelled blood.

The first thing I did was to draw a box around a kink (A), this kink has proven to me that it is something worth paying attention to, because it pushed price down towards a target (red level)

I then blew this chart up on one of my 3 monitors, I waited for good PA. I then saw FL (A) being engulfed, now we have PA!

Now let's zoom into the part where engulf happened. I waited for an FTR to form. I need a least a one full candle to leave the zone before calling it an FTR (hence the comment in red: consolidated away from B).

And then I asked myself, where would be a good entry within this FTR (B)? It should be obvious to you, the best entry is this:

author: Astrokillah
text:
What goes up must come down, vice versa. I have noticed that on USDCAD, liquidity gap (pole) created by RED NEWS event would get filled later on (i.e. price reverse all the way back to the level before RED NEWS)

So I took two long trades with no fear, yeah there were some drawdown but odds is on my side, I added another position at better price. Both hit my conservative target. This is what I meant by 'Contrarian', it's a 'target-based' setup, you need to know where price wants to go eventually.
